support.donate.title: Support by donating via Ko-fi
support.donate.description:
If you enjoy the app and would like to support its continued development, you can make a donation through Ko-fi. Every contribution, no matter the amount, helps me dedicate more time to improving the app, fixing issues, and building new features.

Thank you so much for your support! It truly helps keep the project moving forward.
support.repository.title: Support by starring the GitHub repository
support.repository.description:
If you enjoy the app and want to support the project, consider giving the repository a star on GitHub. It’s a simple way to show your support, help the project gain visibility, and make it easier for others to discover.

Thank you for supporting the project!
support.repository.automation: Go to the Light Host Modern repository
support.showcase.title: Support by showcasing the app
support.showcase.description:
If you create a video about the app, I’d be happy to help give it more visibility. Once your video is published, open an issue on GitHub and send me the link. I may feature your video on the project page, helping promote your content while you help introduce the app to more people.

It’s a simple way for us to support each other: you showcase the app, and I help showcase your work.
